# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 07 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Market

- **Thomson Reserve sells 90.1% at launch, all 3- and 4-bedroom units taken up** - Buyers purchased 1,143 of the development's 1,268 homes at an average price of S$2,900 psf, making it the year's best-selling new condominium launch. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/thomson-reserve-launch-sales/)

- **Freehold Tai Seng industrial building sells en bloc for $121.8M** - 153 Kampong Ampat, a freehold B1 building in Tai Seng, sold for $121.8M — 16% above its guide price — after drawing a competitive bidding process. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/freehold-tai-seng-industrial-building-draws/)

## HDB Resale & BTO

- **Million-dollar HDB resales hit third straight monthly record in October 2026** - A record 238 HDB resale flats changed hands for at least S$1 million in October 2026, up from 209 in September, making up 10.9% of October's total resale volume. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/million-dollar-hdb-resale-record-october-2026/)

- **November 2026 BTO launch: 7,964 flats across seven projects, applications close 11 November** - HDB launched the final BTO exercise of the year on 4 November — the first under higher income ceilings for families — with applications open until 11 November 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/november-2026-bto-launch-highlights/)

- **Yishun executive flat sets new $1.329M record** - A 1,765 sq ft executive flat at Block 652 Yishun Ave 4 sold for $1.329M ($753 psf), setting a new price record even though it is 183 sq ft smaller than the previous record holder. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/yishun-executive-flat-crossed-1-3m/)

## Overseas Property — Buyer Risk

- **84 Singapore buyers of JB luxury condo awarded over $3M after developer delays** - A court ruling found in favour of buyers of a Johor Bahru luxury development, with the case highlighting legal and financial risks for Singapore residents purchasing property overseas. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/rf-princess-cove-buyers-awarded/)
